name: subcontact
description: Sub-contacts — the discretized contact segments where the joint constitutive model acts. This is where joint state / model / property live: 'colorby state' shows slip/separation, 'colorby model' shows the assigned jmodel. 'hide-nforce0' hides segments carrying no normal force.

sub_items.name: colorby
sub_items.description: Categorical colour subcontacts by state, model, property, group, joint-set, dfn, ...

notes: Probe live with 'plot item create <type> ?' to list top-level keywords, then 'plot item create <type> <kw> ?' for sub-options. Keyword sets here are binary-validated against 3DEC 9.0.
verification: Verified against live 3DEC 9.7.47 ('?' enumeration), 2026-08-14. Top-level keyword set is an exact match.
3DEC 7.00 Release 161 (2026-08-21): live first-slot keyword enumeration = active clip color-list colorby cut hide-nforce0 legend map mark pixel-size range scale transparency.

keywords.description: Show or hide the item without removing it.
keywords.name: active

keywords.description: Clip the item against the global model clip box.
keywords.name: clip

keywords.description: Set the discrete colour list used for categorical colouring.
keywords.name: color-list

keywords.description: Categorical colour entities by an attribute (group, type, state, ...). See sub-item 'colorby'.
keywords.name: colorby

keywords.description: Apply a 3D cutting plane to the item.
keywords.name: cut

examples.command: plot item create subcontact colorby state legend active on
examples.description: Show which sub-contacts are slipping / open / bonded. Use case: Joint slip/state

examples.command: plot item create subcontact colorby model legend active on
examples.description: Colour by the assigned joint constitutive model. Use case: By joint model

examples.command: plot item create subcontact colorby state hide-nforce0 on
examples.description: Drop sub-contacts with zero normal force. Use case: Hide unloaded
